items.question: Who rivals the speech-lord with words and becomes all-knowing?
premises: One who rivals speech-lord with words becomes all-knowing.
Verse links verbal rivalry to omniscience.
items.inference: Verbal rivalry with the speech-lord produces omniscience.
uncertainties: Exact referent of vāgīśa and scope of prajāyate remain unclear.
items.plain_english: One who rivals the speech-lord with words becomes all-knowing.
